At this year's career day, two students' parents had early morning slots. One, a lawyer, the other a truck driver. The truck driver unfortunately had to cancel at the last minute, which surprised no one given they never come to any school events, even parent-teacher meetings. The presentation by the lawyer was a delight, though! Who involves themself in their kids education?
A. The truck driver
B. The lawyer
C. Undetermined
